title: Accept misspelled Cloudron volunteer group names
summary: Directory readiness now accepts misspelled Cloudron volunteer group names such as myapesaccount.vounteer and temporary myapesaccont.* prefix typos, mapping them to the canonical myapesaccount.* groups so deploy can succeed while operators finish renames.
changes: Normalize myapesaccount.vounteer and related misspellings to myapesaccount.volunteer during LDAP enumeration and membership resolution.
Accept temporary myapesaccont.* Cloudron group names as aliases of the canonical myapesaccount.* groups.
Document the misspelling aliases and the remaining operator rename to correctly spelled Cloudron groups.
version_rationale: Patch release: backward-compatible deploy readiness fix that maps misspelled directory group names without changing canonical myapesaccount.* authorization semantics.
validation: LdapGroupResolverTest coverage for myapesaccount.vounteer and myapesaccont.* aliases.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main.
known_limitations: Operators should still rename Cloudron myapesaccount.vounteer to myapesaccount.volunteer; aliases are a transition bridge only.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Directory authorization will again require exactly spelled myapesaccount.volunteer.
provenance: Defined by the misspelled Cloudron volunteer group alias fix for MyAPES Account issue #113 under epic #108.

title: Harden merge and deploy reliability gates
summary: Splits CI from Cloudron deploy, adds pre-merge release gates, upgrade-preflight simulation, and clearer deploy failure summaries so merge and deploy fail less often and recover faster.
changes: Split GitHub Actions into test-cloudron.yml and deploy-cloudron.yml so failed deploys can be retried without rerunning the full test matrix.
Retry transient directory_readiness failures during activation preflight and write sanitized failure summaries to GitHub Actions.
Add ProductionUpgradePreflightTest plus composer pre-merge for release and deploy contract checks before push.
Auto-patch ReleaseHistoryCommandTest date indices during changelog prepare and cross-check version-pinned tests in changelog validate.
version_rationale: Patch release hardening merge and deploy reliability without changing end-user product behavior.
validation: DeploymentAuthenticationContractTest, ProductionUpgradePreflightTest, PrepareChangeLogCommandTest, ReleaseHistoryCommandTest, and ChangeLogPageTest.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main.
known_limitations: Deploy still requires live LDAP during preflight; CI simulates legacy catalogue behavior but not production network conditions.
Manual Cloudron staging preflight before merge remains optional and is not automated in this release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. If reverting the workflow split, restore the monolithic Test and deploy workflow from the prior release.
provenance: Defined by merge and deploy reliability hardening for MyAPES Account issue #111 under epic #108.

title: Make LDAP group rename migration idempotent
summary: Cloudron deploy no longer fails when the LDAP group rename migration finds both legacy myapes.* and canonical myapesaccount.* directory groups already present.
changes: Make the myapes-to-myapesaccount directory group rename migration merge duplicate rows instead of renaming into an existing unique name.
Reassign directory mappings and role sources to the canonical group before deleting the legacy duplicate.
version_rationale: Patch release: backward-compatible deploy fix for a partial-upgrade database state without changing authorization semantics.
validation: Feature test covering legacy-plus-canonical directory group merge during migration re-run.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main after filling release notes.
known_limitations: Operators should still rename Cloudron LDAP groups to myapesaccount.* after a successful deploy; this patch only makes the database rename step safe.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. The idempotent rename migration is not reversed automatically on rollback.
provenance: Defined by the duplicate directory group deploy fix for MyAPES Account issue #109 and pull request #110.

title: Accept legacy myapes LDAP groups during deploy readiness
summary: Deploy preflight now accepts legacy myapes.* Cloudron LDAP groups by normalizing them to the canonical myapesaccount.* names, so production can upgrade before operators rename directory groups.
changes: Normalize legacy myapes.* LDAP group names to myapesaccount.* during directory enumeration and managed group filtering.
Allow authorization preflight and super-admin eligibility checks to succeed when production still exposes the previous Cloudron group prefix.
version_rationale: Patch release: backward-compatible deploy fix that maps legacy directory group names during readiness without changing canonical myapesaccount.* authorization semantics after Cloudron groups are renamed.
validation: LdapGroupResolver unit tests for legacy group normalization.
Auth readiness and authorization preflight feature tests with legacy myapes.* groups.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main after filling release notes.
known_limitations: Cloudron operators should still rename groups to myapesaccount.* and run directory sync after deploy; legacy names are accepted only as a transition bridge.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Legacy group normalization is removed on rollback; ensure Cloudron groups match the target release expectations before re-attempting deploy.
provenance: Defined by the deploy directory readiness fix for MyAPES Account issue #106.

title: Fix deploy preflight for authorization guard upgrade
summary: Cloudron deployments from v0.25.0 no longer fail authorization preflight when the database still has the previous authorization guard triggers until the upgrade migration runs.
changes: Allow legacy Phase B authorization guard triggers during preflight while the guard upgrade migration is still pending.
Force reinstall authorization compatibility triggers during the volunteer and student role migration.
version_rationale: Patch release fixing a production deployment blocker introduced in v0.25.0 without changing the LDAP group migration behaviour.
validation: Authorization lifecycle and cutover guard feature tests covering legacy guard detection and preflight acceptance.
Deployment activation contract tests confirming the fail-closed command order is unchanged.
known_limitations: Cloudron LDAP groups must still be renamed to the myapesaccount prefix before directory readiness checks can succeed on production.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release if activation fails after migration; database migrations from v0.25.0 onward are retained and may require backup recovery for a full schema rollback.
provenance: Reconstructed from merged pull request work tracked in issue #104.

title: Migrate LDAP groups to myapesaccount prefix with volunteer and student roles
summary: Staff directory authorization now uses five preset Cloudron groups under the myapesaccount prefix, including new volunteer and student roles, with LDAP-driven user provisioning before first sign-in.
changes: Replaced legacy myapes.* directory groups with five preset myapesaccount.* Cloudron groups mapped to staff, administrator, super-admin, volunteer, and student protected roles.
Synchronize only myapesaccount-prefixed LDAP groups and pre-provision Cloudron OIDC users plus staff profiles during directory sync.
Removed admin enable/disable and custom directory mapping controls; the groups catalogue is read-only apart from manual sync.
Added a data migration to rename legacy directory group records and refresh authorization metadata for existing installs.
version_rationale: Minor release: adds volunteer and student protected roles and changes directory group naming and sync behaviour while keeping existing staff and administrator sign-in paths compatible after Cloudron group migration.
validation: PHPUnit feature and unit suite (excluding GD-dependent attachment tests on hosts without the extension).
Auth readiness and authorization lifecycle command coverage for five preset groups.
Staff OIDC, directory catalogue sync, and role synchronizer regression tests.
known_limitations: Cloudron operators must create or rename the five myapesaccount.* groups and move members off legacy myapes.* groups before deploy.
Volunteer and student groups must exist in LDAP but are not required to contain members for readiness checks.
rollback: Restore the previous release, recreate legacy Cloudron groups if needed, and run directory plus authorization sync after reversing the Cloudron group layout.
provenance: Developed for Issue #101 on branch cursor/feature/101-myapesaccount-ldap-groups.

Aligned preflight eligibility, integrity checks, Local QA fixtures, and documentation with the dual group names.
version_rationale: Patch: backward-compatible fix that adds an alternate exact group name without changing role semantics or public account flows.

php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main after filling release notes.
known_limitations: Cloudron still needs the plural group created and staff assigned before membership takes effect.

rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Authorization sync will restore the prior immutable catalogue on the previous release; no data migration accompanies this patch.
provenance: Defined by the plural Cloudron superadmins group mapping fix for MyAPES Account issue #92 and pull request #100.

Added formal case categories for data access, privacy requests, complaints, membership casework, welfare concerns, and related escalations.

Surfaced ticket and case owner and assigned staff more clearly, including staff reassignment where permitted.
Added database-backed module settings with Super Admin editing for APES CIC tickets and cases.
Restyled the Super Admin modules page to show up to three module cards per row.

version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release that adds new optional fields, settings, and UI capabilities without removing existing ticket or case workflows for other services.
validation: ApesCicTicketCaseEnhancementTest, ApesCicCasesWorkflowTest, ApesCicModuleFoundationTest, ModuleAdministrationAndNavigationTest, ShelterTicketWorkflowTest, and PetCareTicketWorkflowTest feature coverage.
myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: Shelter and Pet Care ticket modules keep their existing flat service areas and do not gain attachments or hierarchical categories in this release.
Module settings editing is limited to APES CIC tickets and cases.
Screencasts are stored for download only; no in-browser playback or transcoding is provided.
rollback: Revert this release record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, migrations for module settings and attachments, ticket and case workflow changes, admin modules UI updates, and related tests. After code rollback, remove newly created module_settings and support_attachments rows if a database recovery is required.

title: MySQL-only runtime and Cloudron Redis

On activate, upsert Redis cache, session, queue, and maintenance keys when CLOUDRON_REDIS_HOST is present, fail closed when it is missing, and default those stores to redis in Laravel config when Cloudron Redis is injected.
affected_areas: GitHub Actions database-compatibility job, database driver allowlists, Cloudron activate-release environment, and cache, queue, and session defaults
version_rationale: A backward-compatible patch aligning the runtime with Cloudron LAMP MySQL and Redis without changing application features or data.
validation: Deployment authentication contract tests cover the MySQL-only contract job, Redis environment upsert, and Cloudron Redis config fallbacks, and source-controlled release-history validation covers this patch record.
known_limitations: This patch does not change application features, authorization, or data. Local and PHPUnit environments still use file, array, and sync stores. MySQL advisory module locks and the CI jobs-table timeout probe remain on the database.
rollback: Revert this patch record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, database-compatibility workflow, driver allowlists, activate-release Redis upsert, and cache, queue, and session defaults. No database rollback is needed.
provenance: Defined by the MySQL-only Cloudron Redis work for MyAPES Account issue #56 and pull request #57.
